dishes.name: Edirne tava ciğer
dishes.desc: Thin slices of liver dusted with flour and fried crisp, served with fried dried chilies and raw onion. The city's best-known dish, with a push to list it with UNESCO.

dishes.name: Ciğer sarma
dishes.desc: Liver wrapped in lamb caul fat and baked with currants, pine nuts, onion and rice. It has a geographical indication as an Edirne dish.

dishes.name: Edirne almond paste
dishes.desc: A dense sweet of almonds, sugar and water that goes back to the Ottoman palace. A shop here has been known for it since 1961.

dishes.name: Deva-i misk
dishes.desc: A helva-like sweet said to date from Mehmed II's time, made with 41 spices and egg white and named for its medicinal, musky character. Sold in Edirne's old sweet shops.

dishes.name: Kandilli mantı
dishes.desc: Layers of baked buttered dough squares soaked in onion broth and served over shredded poultry. Once made with goose or duck, now usually chicken.
